entities.summary: Andrianampoinimerina, a notable figure in the history of Madagascar, associated with Merina Kingdom and Unification (1787–1810). Preceded by Andrianampoinimerina's Unification and Andrianampoinimerina Unifies Merina. Their legacy influenced Radama I and Modernisation and Ranavalona I Expels Europeans.
